thread:
elaine-cs: Quick sync — NovaHealth QBR next Tue. Need final token econ + spend forecast. Main asks: 90-day burn, mitigation options, and one-slide risk+ask. Who can pick which pieces up?

niko-csm: I can own the forecast. Jordan — can you run updated embedding + generation curves? cc @sam-finops for cost modeling.

jordan-analytics: Yep. Pulling last 30d, will incorporate feature rollout dates. ETA EOD today, will post chart and CSV.

sam-finops: I'll draft cost scenarios and two mitigation plays (soft throttle, quantization). Can do baseline vs 20%/40% throttle.

elaine-cs: Also need enablement artifacts: (1) simple token-budget guide for their ops team, (2) credit-alert runbook. Niko, can you coordinate SE ask?

niko-csm: On it. Marco — can you help with the runbook snippet?

marco-se: I can take runbook tomorrow 9–10am PT. Will give a 1-page playbook + an alert snippet.

deploy-bot: Reminder: latest QBR deck template v3 uploaded to /shared/qbr-decks (https://redwood.app/s/qbr-decks). Use slide 4 for 'cost ask'.

jordan-analytics: Posted preview: https://redwood.app/rl/plots/novah-embed-usage.png — embed p95 trending +32% WoW after similar-endpoint rollout. Raw CSV: https://redwood.app/rl/data/novah-usage.csv

elaine-cs: Ugh. That trend explains spike. Recommend we suggest throttling non-critical endpoints and enable KV caching. Sam — can you model savings for throttle 20% vs 40% and adding caching?

sam-finops: Quick back-of-envelope: 20% throttle => ~18% cost reduction; 40% => ~33%. Enabling prefix/KV cache on chat paths adds another ~10–12% for their workloads. I'll validate with the raw traces.

niko-csm: Action items (ETA tomorrow 3pm PT): Jordan — final charts + seq-length distrib; Sam — cost scenarios + two mitigation playbooks with numbers; Marco — runbook + alert snippet; Elaine — compile QBR slides and exec ask slide. I'll drop a task in Asana.

jordan-analytics: Uploaded raw traces + quick note on sequence length tail to the shared doc. Preview link in the deck folder.

niko-csm: Confirming presenter? Elaine, can you lead the QBR?

elaine-cs: I'll present. Need a one-slide 'risk + ask' for execs — please add asks to the doc by 2pm tomorrow.

niko-csm: :thumbsup:

marco-se: Runbook snippet to include in doc:
```
if spend_daily > baseline * 1.25:
  send alert to #customer-success + ops-oncall
  apply temp policy: noncritical-endpoints throttle=20%
  notify SE + finops
```
I'll formalize with play names and run commands.

sam-finops: Recommend budget alerts: warn at 70% of reserved credits, escalate at 90%, hard throttle at 95%. Also include a commercial option: 3-month prepay with modest discount to reduce renewal risk.

elaine-cs: Renewal risk? They are on monthly credits — how urgent is this?

niko-csm: Flagging medium risk. If we see sustained >25% variance we'll trigger commercial outreach. Proactive option: offer prepay or commit-to-cap to stabilize.

jordan-analytics: One more data note: switching to a quantized gen model shows ~12% lower token cost in our tests for their generation mix. Add that as a technical mitigation.

sam-finops: Adding quantization scenario to the cost playbook.

elaine-cs: Great. Reconvene tomorrow 3pm PT to lock slides. Thanks team. :calendar:
